successCriteria.description: src/shared/types/index.ts exports all six canonical enums — LeaveStatus (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), LeaveTypeCode (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity — lowercase persisted values), AuditAction (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT), NotificationStatus (PENDING, SENT, READ, ARCHIVED), EmploymentStatus (ACTIVE, TERMINATED, ON_LEAVE), EmployeeRole (EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, ADMIN) — and the three DTO interfaces CreateLeaveRequestDto, UpdateLeaveRequestDto, LeaveRequestQueryParams.

CreateLeaveRequestDto exposes exactly employeeId, leaveTypeCode, startDate, endDate, reason; UpdateLeaveRequestDto exposes exactly startDate, endDate, reason, status; LeaveRequestQueryParams uses leaveTypeCode (not leaveTypeId) — matching the canonical LeaveRequest entity field names in .gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json.

src/shared/errors/index.ts exports AppError (message, statusCode, code) and subclasses ValidationError(400), NotFoundError(404), UnauthorizedError(401), ForbiddenError(403), ConflictError(409), each carrying the correct statusCode and a stable code string.

src/shared/db/unit-of-work.ts exports IUnitOfWork with withTransaction<T>(work: (tx: unknown) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>, and PgUnitOfWork that acquires a client from the existing pool in src/shared/db/connection.ts, issues BEGIN, runs the callback, COMMITs on success, ROLLBACKs on throw, and always releases the client in a finally.
Jest unit tests exist under tests/unit/shared/ covering the error classes (statusCode + code per subclass) and the enum member sets, and the suite passes via `npx jest`.

constraints: LeaveTypeCode members MUST be lowercase (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity) — DOMAIN.md's scheme is canonical per binding rule #7, overriding the uppercase wording in the task and the stale root ARCHITECTURE.md position.
Use `unknown` with type guards, never `any` (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`, high severity); strict TypeScript (`strict: true`) must compile via `tsc --noEmit`.
PgUnitOfWork must reuse the existing `pool` export from src/shared/db/connection.ts — do not create a second pool or import a module-level db helper elsewhere.
BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK are issued ONLY by PgUnitOfWork; a nested withTransaction must reuse an already-supplied client rather than opening a second transaction.
Tests are Jest-only and live under tests/unit/shared/ (tests/ is excluded from the tsc build via tsconfig `exclude`); no test file may be placed under src/.
outOfScope: No domain modules (employee, leave-type, policy, audit, notification, balance, validation, leave) are built in this phase — only the shared foundation files and their tests.
No base repository, knex migrations, knexfile, or SQL DDL are created in this phase (persistence infrastructure beyond the unit-of-work is deferred).
No HTTP routes, controllers, auth/RBAC guards, or error-response middleware are introduced in this phase.

entityInvariants.invariant: Exposes exactly the five lifecycle states DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED as persisted string values; no extra members.
Exposes exactly six lowercase members annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity; these are the persisted string values in leave_requests.leave_type_code / leave_policies.leave_type.
Exposes exactly CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT.
Exposes exactly PENDING, SENT, READ, ARCHIVED.
Base error carries message, statusCode, and code; every subclass fixes its own statusCode (400/401/403/404/409) and a distinct code, and instances are instanceof AppError.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: On callback throw, ROLLBACK is issued and the original error re-thrown; the client is released in a finally regardless of outcome.
Acquires a client from the shared pool, issues BEGIN before the callback and COMMIT after it resolves; any throw triggers ROLLBACK; release always happens.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: PgUnitOfWork must obtain its client from the existing `pool` export in src/shared/db/connection.ts (the only pool, built from DATABASE_URL with SSL only in production).

Enum member sets and DTO field names must match the canonical entity shapes and module ownership declared in the reconciled architecture (LeaveStatus/LeaveTypeCode/AuditAction/NotificationStatus/EmploymentStatus/EmployeeRole; CreateLeaveRequestDto/UpdateLeaveRequestDto/LeaveRequestQueryParams).

The withTransaction contract must follow the AGENTS.md transaction-boundary decision: service owns the unit of work, data-access layer opens it, repositories take an optional client as the last parameter, and BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK live only in PgUnitOfWork.

Error classes must satisfy the cross-cutting error contract { error, code } with 400/401/403/404/409 semantics (ValidationError→400, UnauthorizedError→401, ForbiddenError→403, NotFoundError→404, ConflictError→409).

integrationPoints.why: PgUnitOfWork depends on its `pool` export; must be read before generating the implementation.

integrationPoints.target: src/modules/employee, leave-type, policy, audit, notification, balance, validation, leave (Phase 2–6)
integrationPoints.why: These later modules import the enums, DTOs, error classes, and IUnitOfWork produced here; the public index.ts files are the authoritative entry points they will consume.
